title: Canvas — a co-drawing surface inside a document

nodes.title: Draw together, in the document
nodes.tagline: the living-surface pattern, with a canvas renderer

sections.name: One surface, a pen each
sections.summary: A `canvas` block embeds a shared Excalidraw board served by the companion codraw runtime. You drag shapes in the browser; the agent authors shapes as code; both poll one scene.json. Point `src` at a running codraw surface (stddoc's setup starts one) and the board mounts inline — prose above and below, unbroken. When there is no src, the primitive degrades loud rather than blanking.

sections.name: Live now, honest when frozen
sections.summary: A canvas is LIVE — it reaches out to its server to exist — so it cannot ship in a frozen doc. At freeze the surface becomes a static placeholder that names what it was and how to get it back. Zero external references; Covenant IV holds. See protocol/canvas.md.
